data.description:

The app is also able to avoid removal by other program manager applications.

*You have heard through the social media grapevine about a "haunted app" called Mal0. Apparently the app sends images of an anthropomorphic wolf with all-black fur and a skull for a face.*

*From what you've heard, the images are taken at locations that the person frequently or recently visited. Eventually, however, the images are seemingly taken right next to the person.*

*Naturally, this app has been the subject of many click-bait videos and articles.*
